## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown documentdemonstrating differential expressuin using RNA-seq
<http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.
The RNA-seq quantification data was  generated by pseudoalignment using Salmon.
The goal in this script is to find differentially expressed genes in the
EO771 cells which are considered as triple neagtive breast cancer cell line.
We were studying effect of Aryl hydrocarbon receptor knock out in this cell line
since 

```{r}
library(tximportData)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.refGene)
#library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

```

```{r}
library(tibble)

res=read.table(file="GRCm39_gene_and_transcript_stable_ID_version.txt",header = T,sep="\t",stringsAsFactors = F)
res=res[,c(1,4)]
colnames(res)=c("GENEID","TXNAME")
res=res[,c(2,1)]
```

```{r}
res_tibble=as_tibble(res)
files=list.files(path="/Users/siddhaduio.no/Desktop/PhD_Project_related/EO771_WT_AhrKOmice_tumors",full.names = T)

files_mut=files[grep("EOCKM",files)]
files_et=files[grep("EOCWM",files)]
files=c(files_mut,files_et)
files=as.data.frame(files)
files_quant=paste(files$files,"/quant.sf",sep="")
```


```{r}
samples=c(paste("EOCKM",1:8,sep=""),paste("EOCWM",1:8,sep=""))
library(tximport)
txi = tximport(files_quant,type = "salmon",tx2gene = res_tibble)
names(txi)
head(txi$counts)
colnames(txi$counts)=samples
head(txi$counts)
```
```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
genotype_info=c(rep("E0771_AHRKO",8),rep("E0771_WT",8))
genotype_info=as.factor(genotype_info)
genotype_info=as.data.frame(genotype_info)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi,~ 0 + genotype_info,colData = genotype_info)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds$group <- factor(paste0(dds$genotype_info))
design(dds) = ~ group
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```
```{r}
library(Glimma)
plotMDS(dds)
glimmaMDS(dds)
## Comparing effect of treatment between E0771 AHRKo and WT
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771 <- results(dds, contrast=c("group","E0771_AHRKO","E0771_WT"),pAdjustMethod = "BH",format = "DataFrame",cooksCutoff = TRUE)
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df=as.data.frame(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771)
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Ensembl=rownames(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df)
summary(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771)
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df=res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df[complete.cases(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df),]

```

```{r}
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Entrez <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Ensembl,keytype="ENSEMBL", column="ENTREZID")
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Symbol <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Entrez,keytype="ENTREZID", column="SYMBOL")
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Genename <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Entrez,keytype="ENTREZID", column="GENENAME")

res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Entrez=as.character(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Entrez)
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Symbol=as.character(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Symbol)
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Genename=as.character(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Genename)

```
## 
Now, I am going to be generating some summary plots including volcano plots and 
Z score heatmaps
```{r}
## Exporting the counts per million file from DESeq2 object for Z score heatmaps
norm_count=cpm(dds,normalised=TRUE)
write.table(norm_count,file="CPM_normalised_counts_regenerated_from_markdown.txt",col.names = T,row.names = T,sep="\t",quote = F)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$Neg_log_p_val=-log10(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$padj)
ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up=subset(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df,res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$log2FoldChange>0.5 & res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$padj < 0.05)
ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn=subset(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df,res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$log2FoldChange < -0.5 & res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$padj < 0.05)

ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up$E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Direction="E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Up"
ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn$E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Direction="E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Down"

ahrko_vs_wt_sig=rbind(ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up,ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn)

ahrko_vs_wt_sig=ahrko_vs_wt_sig[,c("Ensembl","E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Direction")]

ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df=left_join(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df,ahrko_vs_wt_sig,by=c("Ensembl"))
ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Direction[is.na(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Direction)]="No sig change"
ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up=subset(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df,res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$log2FoldChange>0.5 & res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$padj < 0.05)
ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn=subset(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df,res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$log2FoldChange < -0.5 & res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df$padj < 0.05)

ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up$E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Direction=ifelse(ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up$log2FoldChange > 0,"Up")
ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn$E0771_ahrko_vs_wt_Direction=ifelse(ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn$log2FoldChange < 0,"Down")


ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up=ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up[order(- ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up$log2FoldChange),]
ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn=ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn[order(ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn$log2FoldChange),]

top_15_up=ahrko_vs_wt_sig_up
top_15_dn=ahrko_vs_wt_sig_dn[1:10,]

top_15_up$Direction="Up"
top_15_dn$Direction="Down"
top_15_up_dn=rbind(top_15_up,top_15_dn)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)


plot_to_save=ggplot(res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df, aes(y = Neg_log_p_val, x = log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_point(data=res_ahrko_vw_wt_E0771_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=Neg_log_p_val), colour="grey", size=2)+
  geom_point(data = top_15_dn, aes(y = Neg_log_p_val, x = log2FoldChange,color=Direction)) +
  geom_point(data = top_15_up, aes(y = Neg_log_p_val, x = log2FoldChange,color=Direction)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "red", "Down" = "blue"))+ xlim(-22,5) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0,linetype = "longdash") + ylab("-Log10(adj. p val)") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) + ggtitle("E0771, AHRKO vs WT") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),axis.text = element_text(size=10),axis.title = element_text(size=10))+guides(colour=FALSE)+theme(plot.title = element_text(size=10))+theme(legend.title = element_text(size=10),legend.text = element_text(size=10))+geom_text_repel(data=top_15_up_dn,aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=Neg_log_p_val,label=Symbol),color="black",arrow=arrow(ends="last",type="open"),fontface="bold",max.overlaps = 50)+annotate(geom="text", x=10, y=7, label="5 genes up",color="red",size=4)+annotate(geom="text", x=10, y=6.75, label="10 genes down",color="blue",size=4)


plot_to_save


```
